boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain United States Coast Guard Academy
boards.description: Ten food destinations in New London and nearby Groton with publicly posted late hours; confirm service availability before leaving campus.

cards.title: Denny's
cards.subtitle: 322 South Frontage Road, New London
cards.notes: Use the location page to check service options, then choose dine-in, pickup, or delivery for a meal at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 diner option in New London.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists this New London location as open 24/7 and offers dine-in, pickup, and delivery.
cards.source_title: Denny's — 322 South Frontage Road, New London
cards.access_notes: Posted store hours are 12:00 AM–11:58 PM every day; the page describes the location as 24/7.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Colman Street
cards.subtitle: 404 Colman Street, New London
cards.notes: Check the day-specific drive-through or dining-room schedule before heading out, especially when planning a very late pickup.
cards.short_summary: A Colman Street option with service into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-through service until 3 AM daily and until 4 AM Thursday through Saturday at this location.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 404 Colman St, New London
cards.access_notes: Drive-through posted until 3 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 4 AM Thursday–Saturday; dine-in hours are separately posted.

cards.title: Wendy's on Colman Street
cards.subtitle: 370 Colman Street, New London
cards.notes: Choose carryout, dining room, or drive-through service and verify the location page again if operating conditions change.
cards.short_summary: An all-week option posted until 3:30 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-through hours of 10 AM–3:30 AM every day for this New London location.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through are both posted 10:00 AM–3:30 AM daily.

cards.title: McDonald's on Colman Street
cards.subtitle: 406 Colman Street, New London
cards.notes: Use the restaurant locator or app to confirm the active service mode before leaving, since lobby and drive-through hours can differ.
cards.short_summary: A Colman Street location listed through 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: The location listing for McDonald's at 406 Colman Street shows daily hours from 5 AM until 2 AM.
cards.access_notes: A current location listing reports 5:00 AM–2:00 AM daily; confirm service availability in the official locator before travel.

cards.title: Chili's New London
cards.subtitle: 369 North Frontage Road, New London
cards.notes: For a later sit-down meal or pickup, use the official location page and select a Friday or Saturday when midnight hours apply.
cards.short_summary: A family restaurant with midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Chili's lists this New London restaurant open until midnight Friday and Saturday, and until 11 PM Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: 11 AM–11 PM Sunday–Thursday and 11 AM–midnight Friday–Saturday; pickup and delivery are listed.

cards.title: Pizzarama Drive-In
cards.subtitle: 625 Broad Street, New London
cards.notes: Plan for a Friday or Saturday evening if you need the latest posted closing time, and check the restaurant site before ordering.
cards.short_summary: A Broad Street pizza stop open until 10 PM on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizzarama posts hours until 10 PM Friday and Saturday, with 9 PM closing the other days.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are 10:30 AM–10 PM Friday and Saturday, and 10:30 AM–9 PM Sunday through Thursday.

cards.title: Tony D's Italian Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 92 Huntington Street, New London
cards.notes: Reserve or call ahead for dinner, then use the posted Friday or Saturday schedule when planning a late meal downtown.
cards.short_summary: An Italian restaurant with 10 PM weekend closings.
cards.evidence_claim: Tony D's lists Friday and Saturday hours through 10 PM and identifies its New London address.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are 11:30 AM–10 PM Friday and Saturday; other listed dinner nights end at 9 PM.

cards.entity_name: Jasmine Thai Restaurant and Sushi Bar
cards.title: Jasmine Thai Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 470 Bank Street, New London
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s posted dinner schedule to time a takeout or dine-in visit; weekday lunch and dinner hours are separate.
cards.short_summary: Thai and sushi dining with 10 PM Friday and Saturday service.
cards.evidence_claim: Jasmine Thai posts dinner hours until 10 PM Friday and Saturday at 470 Bank Street.
cards.source_title: Jasmine Thai Restaurant and Sushi Bar
cards.access_notes: Dinner is posted until 10 PM Friday and Saturday, 9:30 PM Monday–Thursday and Sunday.

cards.title: Empire Pizza
cards.subtitle: 150 Broad Street, New London
cards.notes: Place a pickup or dine-in plan before the posted cutoff, using Friday or Saturday for the latest listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Broad Street pizza option listed until 9:45 PM on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Empire Pizza lists dine-in, pickup, and takeout at 150 Broad Street, with Friday and Saturday hours until 9:45 PM.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours end at 9:45 PM Friday and Saturday and 9:30 PM Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: Sneekers Cafe
cards.subtitle: 568 Poquonnock Road, Groton
cards.notes: For a nearby off-campus dinner, check the cafe’s schedule and confirm seating or takeout details directly before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Groton cafe posted open until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Sneekers Cafe lists hours of 11 AM–midnight Tuesday through Sunday at its Groton location.
cards.access_notes: The official restaurant page posts Tuesday–Sunday hours of 11 AM–12 AM; confirm availability before travel.
